preparationInternalReview.method: Controller and independent read-only reviewer inspected existing extracted ability JSON and source metadata. No fresh original-block extraction/hash check; no game input.
conclusions: The static configuration explicitly binds preparatory projectile triggers to Attack_Execute_01_Pre before its later entry dodge listener. Pre is not synonymous with the single entry response.

Preparation and PreparationPress are experiment input-plan terms; they do not identify a separate game state. Preparation dodge 1/2 label the chosen player response route, not official attack names or projectile counts.
The eleven trigger entries differ from sixteen registered abilities and from required player keydowns. Do not infer eleven dodges or a measured onscreen projectile count.
Triggered bullets 01/05/11/14 reference LocalAvatar; others reference caster HitPoints. All reviewed rotation settings specify TargetUpdateMode OnStart. Continuous player tracking is not established.
